info.title: Is Even API
info.description: The Is Even API checks whether a given integer is even or odd. It provides a simple endpoint where you can submit a number and receive a response indicating its parity.

get.summary: Check if a number is even
get.description: Returns whether a given number is even or odd. Allowed numbers depend on your API tier: Public (0-999,999), Premium (0-999,999,999), Enterprise (0-999,999,999,999). All tiers support negative numbers.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: The number you want to check for even or odd parity

iseven.description: True if the number is even, false if odd

ad.description: Advertisement text (present in free tier, removed in Premium and Enterprise tiers)
